test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 14 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: ΔEFG is a right angled triangle. ∠F = 90 degree, EF = 10 cm and FG = 15 cm. What is the value of cosec G?
solution:
**Given:**

∠F = 90 degree

EF = 10 cm

FG = 15 cm

**Concept Used:**

Pythagoras Theorem;

Hypotenuse² = Perpendicular² + Base²

cosecθ = Hypotenuse/Perpendicular

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fdd28c54c318ab7ce29a3f86e0980139782c2d87931deb6a72c359a8adb6b2b7.png] 

EG² = EF² + FG²

⇒ EG² = 100 + 225

⇒ EG = √325 cm

⇒ cosecG= √325/10

⇒ √13/2

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**
